（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 53
Date 4-2-16
4th February 1916

Sir,

It is reported that the troops at the Arsenal
were expecting a gratuity on new year's eve, and
were very disappointed when they received none.

It is reported that the rebels in Frenchtown
are recruiting for a corps called Thau Yuan Kyuin 討袁軍
the headquarters of which are in Hangchow.

Special precautions were taken in the City on
the eve of the new year and last night, but nothing
untoward transpired.

Your obedient servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

.10
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

上海工部局。

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记册
第 53 号
日期 16-2-4
1916年2月4日

先生：

据报，兵工厂的士兵曾在除夕夜期待发放赏金，因未收到而深感失望。

据报，法租界的反叛者正在为一支名为“讨袁军”的部队招募人员，其总部设在杭州。

除夕夜及昨晚，华界已采取特别预防措施，但未发生任何意外事件。

您忠实的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察

警务处总监上尉
